Name: Island Tropical Forage
Author: Fungidelight
Description:
This is a small FTM-compatible mod that adds tropical forage to Ginger Island.

No need to grow mango and banana trees any more! Just head into the jungle, and the sweet juicy fruits will be waiting for you on the forest floor.

Also, coconuts and pineapples will wash up on the island farm beach.

I may add configurable forage quantity and type in the future, but for now the mod spawns 2-4 items in each location daily. All items are equally likely to spawn. Since they are picked up as forage, they will benefit from Gatherer and Botanist professions.

Downloads.Description: Restricted spawn areas so that fruit no longer spawn in unreachable areas. Added update key to manifest.json
